question: Self-Consistency 中单次正确率 p 的估算：在 GSM8K 等数学推理基准上，Qwen-27B 级别的模型单次 CoT 准确率 p 约为 0.6-0.7。代入 S(K) = 1 - (1-p)^K，当 K=5 时，S(5) ≈ 1 - 0.3^5 ≈ 99.9% (若 p=0.7) 或 1 - 0.4^5 ≈ 99.4% (若 p=0.6)，显示出显著的边际收益。

sources.title: Self-Consistency Boosts Calibration for Math Reasoning
sources.snippet: Abstract Calibration, which establishes the correlation between accuracy and model confidence, is important for LLM development.
